title: Shared links catalog
description:
Topic-grouped catalog of sites, repositories, packages, and other links.

Conventions:
- Topics are domains (what it's about).
- type is the artifact kind (what the target is).
- tags are optional extras not already implied by topic or type.
- Array order is display order.
- Icon/accent paths without a scheme are resolved relative to the item url (join against url as base).
- Skip topics/items with hidden: true unless explicitly showing drafts/examples.
- featured marks items eligible for highlight surfaces; omit when false.
- repo is the source repository when it differs from url.

topic.description: Domain grouping (e.g. Data & Analytics, Other, Meta).

hidden.description: When true, consumers should omit this entire topic from normal listings (e.g. schema examples).

id.description: Stable kebab-case slug. Prefer keeping this unchanged if the label or url moves.

subtitle.description: Short one-line blurb shown next to the label.

description.description: Longer Markdown body. Omit when unused.

url.description: Primary target URL for the link.

repo.description: Source repository URL when it differs from url—e.g. a Pages site, package page, releases page, or store listing.

icon.description: Default (light) icon. Absolute URI, or path relative to url.

iconDark.description: Optional dark-mode icon override. Absolute URI, or path relative to url.

type.description: What the target is (single primary kind).

tags.description: Optional cross-cutting labels not already implied by topic or type. Omit when empty.

featured.description: When true, eligible for highlight/featured surfaces. Omit when false.

hidden.description: When true, consumers should omit this item from normal listings. Omit when false.

assetRef.description: Absolute http(s) URI, or a path relative to the item url (no scheme/host).
